model: INMBSHIS001R000 Hisense AC to Modbus RTU gateway
applies_to: Hisense commercial-line indoor units on the AB remote-controller bus, user manual v1.6 (01/2024).
summary: Modbus RTU server that connects to the AB remote-controller bus of a Hisense commercial indoor unit. Holding registers cover on/off, mode, fan, vane, setpoint, external temperature input, window contact, alarm and error code, min/max setpoints, return-air temperature and gateway configuration.

addressing.note: Tables give a 'protocol address' (base 0) and a 'PLC address' (base 1); the protocol address is the wire address and is used for 'documented'.

source.title: Intesis INMBSHIS001R000 Modbus RTU (EIA-485) Interface for Hisense air conditioners - User's Manual
source.pages: pp. 8-10 (registers), pp. 10-12 (temperature notes), pp. 13-15 (DIP switches), p. 16 (functions)

notes: The manual declares every register a 16-bit unsigned holding register; the 'no value' marker written as -32768 is raw 0x8000 (32768), listed as an enum entry.

Temperature registers follow the SW4 setting: x1 °C, x10 °C or °F (no °F x10). The register-table footnote calls x10 the default, but the DIP-switch table marks x1 degrees and Celsius as the factory setting, so scale 1 / °C is used here. Check SW4 on site: with x10 use scale 0.1; with °F the values are whole °F.
Baud rate (14) is read-only here and is set on SW3/SW4; the manual does not list the numeric codes it returns, so no value table is given.
FC16 is accepted but only with a length of 1 register per write.
Error code list (Hisense codes) not reproduced; see manual section 6.

integration.summary: Set address and baud on SW3/SW4, wire A+/B- to the EIA-485 bus and AB to the indoor unit, then write registers 0-4 and poll 5, 10, 11 and 66. Write room temperature to register 22 if a Modbus-side sensor should drive the unit.
integration.enable: No enable step; writes act at once unless register 7 (gateway disablement) is set to 1.
quirks: Temperature scale depends on SW4 (x1 / x10 / °F).
With an external temperature written to 22, the gateway shifts the real setpoint (register 23) so the unit's own sensor tracks your setpoint; the wall controller may then show a different setpoint.
FC16 writes must be one register long.
setup: 8N2 (8N1 detected automatically), 9600 baud default, set on SW3/SW4.
SW1 sets the gateway as AB-bus slave (default, needs a Hisense remote as master) or master.
gotchas: When the gateway is AB-bus slave, a Hisense remote controller configured as master must be present.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
